# Job Harness

> Local-first AI job search workbench, job application tracker, and MCP server written in Rust (with a native GPUI desktop app). Works with Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, Cursor, Pi, or any MCP/CLI agent.

Job Harness gives AI agents durable career memory and hard safety rails while keeping all data private on your machine in plain Markdown, JSON, and local SQLite.

## What Job Harness solves
- **One truthful career ledger:** Master CV (`content/baseline.json`), role-focused child CV tracks (Typst/PDF), approved screening answers, CARL story bank, interview debriefs, and submitted packets in one local folder.
- **Transactional submission safety:** Freezes immutable SHA-256 packets (`prepare_application`), enforces daily caps, checks live Sent mail before sending, and blocks duplicate retries when an outcome is unconfirmed.
- **Agent- and model-agnostic:** Runs as a local stdio MCP server (`jh mcp`) and CLI (`jh`). Switch between Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, Cursor, Pi, or local models without losing history.
- **Native desktop workbench (GPUI):** Instant Kanban board, interactive Sankey funnel (distinguishing Rejected, Withdrawn, Expired, and Ghosted), 2-layer company + round interview briefs, inline profile/delegation settings, and live streaming agent chat.
- **Zero credentials in workspace:** Uses host CLI OAuth and an owner-only (`0600`) 1-use self-destructing ephemeral secret vault (`jh secret`) with TTL expiry.

## Quick start
- Install CLI: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/machineyearningengineer/job-harness/main/scripts/get.sh | sh`
- Initialize workspace: `jh setup --workspace "$HOME/Career/workspace"`
- Print MCP config: `jh --root "$HOME/Career/workspace" connect mcp`
- Try desktop demo: `make desktop-demo`
- Agent one-shot setup guide: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/machineyearningengineer/job-harness/main/docs/AGENT-SETUP.md
